adapter.title: Bluetooth adapter
adapter.description: Which Bluetooth adapter should talk to the clock? It needs Classic Bluetooth and to be within range of the clock.

known.title: Choose a clock
known.description: These clocks are already paired with this adapter.

prepare.title: Put the clock into pairing mode
prepare.description: Remove the clock from the Alexa app (or switch off its Echo), then put it into pairing mode (see its manual). Keep it close to the Bluetooth adapter and continue: Home Assistant looks for it for 20 seconds.

progress.scan: Looking for clocks in pairing mode…

error.none_found: No clock in pairing mode was found. Check that it's in pairing mode and close by, then try again.
error.scan_failed: Looking for clocks failed. Is the Bluetooth adapter working?
error.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Put the clock into pairing mode again and retry.

abort.already_configured: This clock is already set up.
abort.no_bluetooth_sockets: This Python can't open Bluetooth sockets (built without Bluetooth support).
abort.no_bluez: BlueZ isn't reachable over the system D-Bus.
